# Amr Adel

> .NET Full Stack Developer building full-stack business websites, custom admin dashboards, and automation for real, operating businesses — not demos.

Amr Adel is a .NET Full Stack Developer based in Egypt, working primarily with Angular, .NET Web API, and SQL Server. He designs, builds, and deploys complete business platforms: a public-facing website plus a private admin dashboard the business owner can use to manage content, offers, and bookings without writing code.

## Services

- **Business Website** (1–2 weeks): a conversion-focused marketing site with a WhatsApp-first booking/inquiry flow, often bilingual Arabic/English.
- **Website + Admin Dashboard** (2–4 weeks): a full platform with a custom admin dashboard backed by a database, built on Angular + .NET Web API + SQL Server.
- **Custom & Automation** (scoped per project): workflow automation, integrations, and custom systems beyond a standard website.

Payment is staged — each stage is paid once that part of the work is delivered.

## Real, Live Client Projects

- [El Sayed Hassan Auto](https://elsayedhassanauto.com/) — a Nissan-only car service center in Giza with a full booking platform and admin dashboard.
- [Maratebalhamd](https://maratebalhamd.com/) — an authorized Habitat/Janssen/Sleep High mattress showroom in Faisal, Giza.
- [Hamada Ramadan Painter](https://hamada-ramadan-painter.vercel.app/) — a lead-generation site for an interior finishing & painting contractor in Nasr City, Cairo.
- [Hamada El-Gabry Stables](https://hamadaelgabrystables.com/) — a horse riding and desert safari booking platform at the Giza Pyramids, rated 4.9/5 from 2,600+ Google reviews.
